t: This is Brondesbury College for Boys, a selective independent school in Brent. It was founded in 1996 by Yusuf Islam, the singer-songwriter once known as Cat Stevens, as part of the Waqf Al-Birr Educational Trust. The aim was to give young Muslim students in the United Kingdom a school of their own. Yusuf Islam has sold more than a hundred million records, and here his focus is education. The school reported an 83 percent pass rate at five or more GCSEs, grades A star to C, in 2014.
